description: (Na)₂LiYBr₆ is High-temperature superconductor-derived structured and crystallizes in the cubic Fm̅3m space group. The structure consists of eight Na clusters inside a LiYBr₆ framework. In each Na cluster, Na is bonded in a 1-coordinate geometry to  atoms. In the LiYBr₆ framework, Li is bonded to six equivalent Br atoms to form LiBr₆ octahedra that share corners with six equivalent YBr₆ octahedra. The corner-sharing octahedra are not tilted. All Li-Br bond lengths are 2.69 Å. Y is bonded to six equivalent Br atoms to form YBr₆ octahedra that share corners with six equivalent LiBr₆ octahedra. The corner-sharing octahedra are not tilted. All Y-Br bond lengths are 2.77 Å. Br is bonded in a linear geometry to one Li and one Y atom.
